response.justification: Bogdan's resume shows strong experience in full-stack development, primarily in web and mobile domains, but lacks the mandatory 5–10 years of hands-on C++ development experience on Windows platforms required for this role. His C++ experience is limited to early career roles (2014–2015) and does not meet the domain-specific or technical depth needed. Additionally, he has no demonstrated experience in capital markets, investment banking, or fixed-income systems.
strengths: Strong full-stack development skills across multiple languages and frameworks (TypeScript, Node.js, React, etc.).
Experience with test-driven development, CI/CD, and modern software engineering practices.
Proven ability to build scalable systems and contribute to open-source projects.
concerns: Insufficient C++ experience on Windows (only ~1 year in early career; does not meet 5–10 year requirement).
No domain expertise in capital markets, investment banking, or fixed-income systems.
Lacks required SQL Server/Oracle experience or Summit platform knowledge.
